name: card_post_project_visual_devices_media
title: Card Post Project Visual - Devices Media
description: Renders a project's media as device mockups: the first photo on a portrait tablet and the first video on a landscape tablet (both, or just one with "show"). Photo: same lookup as card_post_project_visual_media. Video: the first video in src/content/vid/projects/<media.path>/ (and its subfolders) with a data_items_video.json video_thumbnail is shown as that image, otherwise the first video. Frames come from data_content_post_projects.json (img.devices.tablet / tablet-landscape). Set "link": false to render it without the link.
